facts.text: Burnaby has over 13,000 businesses and more than 125,000 workers, supporting over 148,000 job opportunities in total.
In 2024, major film and streaming companies spent more than $184 million in Burnaby on local goods and services, supporting over 1,149 local businesses.
Burnaby hosts about 550 days of on-location filming annually, and nearly two-thirds of all studio space in Metro Vancouver is found in Burnaby.
Bridge Studios' Lake City Studios campus in Burnaby, completed in 2025, is the largest production facility in Canada with 21 purpose-built soundstages.
Metrotown is Burnaby's regional city centre and downtown, and is the largest of the city's four town centres, offering more regionally based businesses and services.

overview: Burnaby counted 249,125 residents in the 2021 Census, up 7.0 percent from 232,755 in 2016, on a compact 90.57 square kilometres between Vancouver and the Tri-Cities. The median age is 40.4 and the median household income was $83,000 in 2020, with 101,136 occupied dwellings increasingly concentrated in the towers of Metrotown, Brentwood, Lougheed and Edmonds.

Film and television production, post-secondary institutions and thousands of small businesses drive the economy. For a local business, Burnaby offers a dense, multilingual and growing customer base organized around four town centres, so success depends on being visible in the right one rather than across the whole city.
